## Names

<a id="char_row_screen_lo"></a>
### [`char_row_screen_lo`](../../../src/char_row_tables.asm#L8) `$50E7-$50FE`

*data*

Char row address tables (24 entries): entry r = screen row r+1. char_row_screen_lo/hi = $8C28 + 40r (game_screen + 40 + 40r), char_row_colour_hi with the same low byte = colour RAM $D828 + 40r. Used by set_char_row_pointers.

- **Referred to by:** [`set_char_row_pointers`](background_contact.md#set_char_row_pointers) [`$55C5`](../../../src/background_contact.asm#L498)
